name: veille-mcp
description: Veille fraud prevention API for Claude.
long_description: Validate emails, domains, IPs, VAT numbers and IBANs in milliseconds to block fake sign-ups, bots and fraud.

tools.name: intelligence_domain
tools.description: Check any domain instantly. Detects disposable email providers, public webmail, relay services, and education domains. Returns DNS health with MX provider detection, domain history, and optional SSL/…

tools.name: intelligence_email
tools.description: Validate any email address in a single call. Detects disposable and temporary inboxes, identifies role accounts, public webmail, relay services, and returns a 0-100 risk score. For deep deliverabilit…

tools.name: intelligence_emailq
tools.description: Deep email deliverability verification. Performs full Email Validation plus SMTP inbox check, catch-all detection, and returns a qualification verdict (valid, invalid, risky, disposable, unknown).

tools.name: intelligence_ip
tools.description: Assess the reputation of any IP address. Detects VPNs, proxies, Tor exit nodes, datacenter hosting, abusive traffic, and bots. Returns geolocation, network owner, and a 0-100 threat score.

tools.name: intelligence_phone
tools.description: Validate any phone number in E.164 format. Detects disposable and virtual numbers, identifies carrier and line type (mobile/fixed/VoIP), returns country and timezone, and computes a 0-100 risk score.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Infrastructure health for an engine or endpoint over the last hour. Not scoped to your account or tenant. Enabled per account: HTTP 403 means contact support to activate it.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Retrieve real-time usage statistics and credit balance for your Veille account.

tools.name: vat
tools.description: Validate a European VAT number against the VIES database. Returns company name, registered address, and validity status for any EU member state.

tools.name: vat_iban
tools.description: Validate any IBAN and retrieve associated bank details. Returns the BIC/SWIFT code, bank name, country, BBAN structural breakdown, and SEPA zone membership.

tools.name: vat_rates
tools.description: Get current ECB exchange rates for any supported base currency. Optionally filter to specific target currencies. Updated daily from the European Central Bank.
